description: Read the facts of one call by the id from search_open_calls, with its summary and official link.

id.description: The call's id, as returned by search_open_calls or list_my_matches, for example ted-728925-2026.

language.description: Language for titles. A title comes translated only where Gondar has a translation (titleIsAutomaticTranslation); otherwise it stays in its source language, named in titleLanguage. Summaries always stay in the source language.

name: get_open_call
title: Read one open call
